Why NiftyHMS?

NiftyHMS is the Healthcare Software to ease your practitioner’s responsibilities and provide flexibility. Through NiftyHMS we provide you access to remote consulting, care at home, and practice manage EMR in 1 platform. Our software will allow you to deliver proactive patient care, improve patient retention and expansion, boost healthcare access, and increase revenue. We are a patient-centric solution that is accessible anywhere, anytime, and on any device.

## Special Care at your convenience

### Care at Home

Due to a covid lot of Patients need Doctor consulting at the comfort of home.

### Virtual Consulting

Improve access to people who live in rural areas and provide care for those who lack transportation to receive care in person.

### Save Time

Increase availability by reducing travel time needed from in-person appointments, that is late due to traffic.

[SCHEDULE A DEMO](https://niftyhms.com/schedule-demo/)

Manage Your Practice with More Ease

### Flexibility

With an online time scheduler and virtual consulting, Doctors get the flexibility of working from home or the clinic.

### Do More with Less

Tech Enables Remote Consulting will need fewer staff than the physical setup.

### Increased Revenue

Doctors will get new leads from Patients through our platform resulting in additional revenues.

What is NiftyHMS?

The ideal healthcare software to complete clinic operations. A patient-centric solution that is accessible from anywhere, anytime, and on any device.

[Cloud Version](https://niftyhms.com/#container-1)

[Anytime Anywhere](https://niftyhms.com/#container-2)

[HIPAA Compliance](https://niftyhms.com/#container-3)

- Overall ease of deployment since the software is hosted with a world-class cloud server instead of your location.
- No need for on-site servers or an IT staff to install and maintain the necessary software.
- Say goodbye to lengthy, sometimes confusing, and costly installations.
- A few simple online steps and an entire Cloud-based software can be set up and ready to use, all in a matter of hours.

[SCHEDULE A DEMO](https://niftyhms.com/schedule-demo/)

- Mobile access to corporate data via smartphones, tablets and other devices.
- We offer conveniently accessible information to sales staff, freelance employees or remote employees for better work-life balance.
- 24X7 Accessibility to the software on their own, from anywhere in or out of the office.
- Employees who are on the go, can capture real-time insights and make updates at any time, anywhere.
- Remote Accessibility gives a real edge to the virtual workforce and multinational teams.

- We carefully monitor security, which is significantly more efficient than a conventional in-house system.
- Amped-up security is achieved through encryption of data being transmitted over networks and stored in databases.
- Data is secured with SSL encryption and adhere to stringent data regulations.
- Constantly monitoring the system for any changes, following redundant
data policies and performing frequent data backups.

How NiftyHMS Works?

NiftyHMS is a secure, cost-effective health software to deliver proactive patient care. This mobile and web-based platform stores the patient’s complete health records, enable instant access to emergency care, provides a quick and easy approach to scheduling appointments with care providers.

### On-Demand Virtual Consultations 24/7

Through Video conferencing patient consultations by doctor goes virtual.

### Home Nursing Care at Your Fingertips

Enabled through Wearable tech and health data in real-time.

### **Manage EMR in a Single Platform**

HIPPA compliant web app that can store all patient data in a central database.

![WhatsApp Boking GIF for Web](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/WhatsApp-Boking-GIF-for-Web-.gif)

### Securely Manage Patient Data Through EMR

Record every aspect of a patient’s health data like body vitals, health conditions, medications, vaccinations, surgeries, hospitalizations, social history and more.

### E-Prescriptions – The Better, Safer   way to Prescribe Meds

Doctors can generate e-prescriptions for patients for future references and medication by both doctors and patients. It also reduces the chances of error by illegible handwriting.

### Easy to Manage Patient Appointment & Follow up

System provides timely follow-up to practitioners for checking reports or recalling the patient for checkups. Patients also get reminders about the schedule to visit the doctors.

### Deliver Proactive Patient Care and Improve Outcomes

Collect, store and report data from medical wearables and sync it into the software. It helps doctors monitor patients remotely with chronic conditions and sends alert messages when body vitals are out of range.

Why Choose NiftyHMS For Dental Practice?

NiftyHMS makes running your dental clinic easy by handling appointments, Patient records, Treatments, billing, and communication. It manages treatments like Teeth Cleaning, Oral Surgery, Root Canals, Extractions, and Cosmetic Dentistry, helping you deliver exceptional patient care efficiently.

- [Appointment](https://niftyhms.com/for-dentist/#Content-6da479a67a97612b97a4)
- [Queue management](https://niftyhms.com/for-dentist/#Content-80d975167a97612b97a4)
- [Treatment Planning](https://niftyhms.com/for-dentist/#Content-671a5b167a97612b97a4)
- [Dental Chart](https://niftyhms.com/for-dentist/#Content-4f1a12367a97612b97a4)
- [Sessions](https://niftyhms.com/for-dentist/#Content-3f9736767a97612b97a4)
- [Billing & Payment](https://niftyhms.com/for-dentist/#Content-5a8dd8567a97612b97a4)

## Dental Appointment Bot

Easy to Setup and Reschedule Dental Appointments.

See appointments in real time to avoid double bookings.

Get automatic reminders to reduce missed appointments.

Priority scheduling for urgent treatments like Root Canals or Extractions.

Keep track of all patient appointments.

![Dental Appointment Booking bot](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Dental-Appointment-Booking-bot.png)

## Queue Management

Track patient flow from arrival to treatment completion.

Assign patients to available Dental practitioners based on need.

Real-time updates to patients on wait times.

Manage walk-ins efficiently without disrupting scheduled appointments.

Optimize patient movement to improve clinic efficiency.

![Queue Management](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Queue-Management.png)

## Treatment Planning

Create treatment plans for procedures like Fillings, Veneers, or Teeth Whitening.

Track multi-visit treatments like Braces or Cosmetic Dentistry.

Update and share treatment details with patients after each visit.

Schedule follow-up visits for long-term care.

![Treatment Planning](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Treatment-Planning.png)

## Dental Chart

Keep digital records of each patient’s oral health.

Annotate charts for conditions like Cavities, Wisdom Teeth Removal, or Implants.

Update charts after treatments like **Dental Implants**.

Quickly access patient charts during appointments.

![Advanced Dental Charting](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Advanced-Dental-Charting-.png)

## Session Tracking

Keep track of long-term treatments like **Braces** or **Root Canals.**

Record each session’s details and results.

Collect feedback from patients after each session.

View all session details in one place for easy access.

![Session Tracking](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Session-Tracking.png)

## Simple Billing & Payments

Easy billing for treatments like **Teeth Cleaning** or **Crown Placement.**

Accept different payment methods for patient convenience.

Clear and itemized bills for services like **Bridges** or **Fillings.**

Track payments and send reminders for unpaid bills.

Keep financial records simple and easy to manage.

![Simple Billing Payments](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Simple-Billing-Payments.png)

NiftyHMS Empowers Your Dental Team to Deliver Better Care

NiftyHMS is your All-In-One Software Solution for Dental Practices. Learn How we can Transform your Workflow, Enhance efficiency and support your Financial Growth.

Manage Multiple Clinic

Effortlessly oversee multiple clinic locations with centralized patient records and operational details accessible from anywhere.

![Manage Multiple Clinic](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Dental-Clinic-1-1.png)

Smart Practice Dashboard

Instantly access appointments, invoices, and payments in one streamlined view. Manage patient bookings with a simple, intuitive calendar.

![Smart Practice Dashboard](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Dental-Clinic-2-1.png)

Convert to a Digital Clinic

Go paperless with features like EMR (Electronic Medical Records), appointment scheduling, dental charts, X-ray management, patient history tracking, and treatment planning.

![Convert to a Digital Clinic](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Dental-Clinic-3-2.png)

Anytime, Anywhere

This platform allows you to manage your Dental practice from any device, giving you the freedom to work anytime and anywhere.

![Anytime, Anywhere](https://niftyhms.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Dental-Clinic-1-copy-1.png)

Frequently Asked Questions \[FAQs\]

How can dental software improve patient care?

Dental software like NiftyHMS can streamline appointment scheduling, enhance communication, and provide quick access to patient records. This leads to better patient care, allowing easier management of treatments like **Dental Implants, Crown Placement, Teeth Whitening, Fillings, Orthodontics, Cosmetic Dentistry**,and more.

What are the levels of dental practice management software?

There are different levels of dental practice management software: basic, mid-level, and advanced. Each offers different features to meet various practice needs, including handling complex treatments like **Root Canal Therapy, Dental Braces, Veneers,** and **Teeth Cleaning.**

How much does dental software cost?

Costs can vary, generally ranging from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month. The price depends on the features and service level, such as managing **Pediatric Dentistry, Tooth Extractions,** or advanced **Oral and Maxillofacial** Surgery procedures.

What is CRM in dentistry?

CRM (Customer Relationship Management) in dentistry, like the features provided by NiftyHMS, helps manage relationships and interactions with patients. It improves communication and service, allowing dental practices to track treatments such as **Scaling and Root Planing, Dental Bonding,** and **Bridge Placement.**

What does ERP stand for in dental?

ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) in dental software optimizes business processes such as inventory control, financial reporting, and overall practice management. It can help improve operations for services like **Wisdom Teeth Removal, Endodontics**, and **Prosthodontics.**

Can dental software be accessed remotely?

Yes, many dental software solutions, including NiftyHMS, are cloud-based. This allows practitioners to access patient information and manage their practice from anywhere, anytime, on any device.

How does NiftyHMS support dental practices?

NiftyHMS supports dental practices by simplifying scheduling, improving patient communication, and enhancing billing. It also helps manage treatments such as **Dentures, Fillings, Cosmetic Dentistry, Oral Surgery**, and **Teeth Whitening.**

Can dental software support multiple settings?

Yes, dental software like NiftyHMS can be set up to manage multiple practice locations, streamlining operations and patient records across different settings.

Can dental software support multiple treatment settings?

Yes, dental software like NiftyHMS allows you to manage multiple treatment settings for each patient. This means you can track various procedures and visits, such as **Dental Implants, Fillings, Orthodontics**, and **Scaling and Root planning**, all in one system, ensuring coordinated care across different stages of treatment.

How does NiftyHMS help with treatment planning?

NiftyHMS helps dental teams create and manage personalized treatment plans for patients, tracking progress for procedures such as **Dental Implants, Braces, Veneers**, and **Extractions**, ensuring comprehensive care and timely follow-ups.
